Production audit is green and CSV/JSON limits improved, but stream cleaning still bypasses exact-target validation; Excel/PDF parsing remains post-materialization; Multer failure cleanup and meaningful replacement/SSE tests are missing.

Stream cleaning now uses the exact validator and the production audit remains clean, but Excel/PDF still materialize unbounded row structures, Multer partial-file cleanup is unproven/incomplete, and replacement/SSE tests do not exercise real endpoint and post-header failure paths.

All required gates pass; Excel worksheet XML preflight, bounded PDF/LLM parsing, tracked Multer cleanup, endpoint replacement behavior, and authenticated post-header SSE failure behavior are directly verified.
